title: The Pier Wakes
summary: On Day fourteen, Sam walks onto a pier full of the infected to get her dog back.

beats.text: Marek's shout woke the whole pier.
He ran up the tug's ramp with Biscuit.
Mrs. Okafor set Leo's walkie hissing on a barrel.
"Noise is a tool, dear. Lend it to them."
beats.speaker: okafor

beats.text: The static pulled them down the pier, away from the tug.
We crept along the containers. Hale held the real key.
Marek stood at the rail. Biscuit sat silent under his coat.
Marek crumpled. "I only wanted off this coast," he whispered. "Take him."
Biscuit leapt into my arms. For once in his life, he did not bark.
Hale slid the key in. "Everyone aboard," he whispered. "Quietly."
beats.speaker: hale

beats.text: The engine coughed once. Then it roared.
Every head on Pier Four turned. And Leo's walkie went dead.
